purpose: Reserve the next genuinely unseen sessions for one-shot falsification of frozen Dynamic State v5 versus frozen v4 without outcome-driven date selection.

eligibility.selectionRule: Take chronological JPX sessions from 2026-09-10 onward as they become reconstructable; never replace a reserved session because of its outcome.

candidateLock.firstBarRule: directional close return < 0 enters DEFENSIVE; otherwise continue frozen v4
candidateLock.recoveryRule: first completed managed close with directional return >= 0 by elapsed bar 6 promotes to RECOVERED and continues frozen v4
candidateLock.failureRule: no reclaim by elapsed bar 6 exits at completed bar-6 close

decisionRule.supportive: v5-v4 paired net delta > 0, PF >= v4, drawdown not worse by >1 percentage point, no material premature-winner regression, and improvement not dominated by one trade
decisionRule.mixed: directionally useful but sample/robustness criterion insufficient
decisionRule.reject: paired net delta <= 0 or material drawdown/premature-winner regression
